{
  "phoneNote": "The double-framed olive label motif works well, but the primary button looks broken with left-aligned underlined text, and the entire contact and opening hours block is duplicated at the bottom.",
  "desktopNote": "The hero arch and label card create a distinctive Istrian deli feel, though the two-photo gallery leaves half the screen empty and the footer repeats the contact section right above it.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Remove the duplicate address, directions link, and opening hours from the 'Obiščite nas' footer block since they appear immediately above in the contact section.",
    "Fix the primary CTA button ('Darilni paketi') in the hero card by removing the text underline and centering the label with proper horizontal padding.",
    "Scale up the two photos in 'Utrinki iz trgovine' on desktop to span the full container width instead of leaving the right half of the row blank."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On both phone and desktop, the entire address, directions link, and opening hours table are repeated verbatim in the contact section and the footer right below it."
  ]
}
